appDescription: A driving coach app that gives beginner drivers real-time voice guidance based on vehicle signals and upcoming road situations.

function.name: START_DRIVING_COACH
function.description: Starts a real-time voice coaching session that guides the driver while driving.

function.name: ASK_CAR_TIP
function.description: Explains how to use a vehicle feature that beginner drivers often find confusing, such as defogging, air recirculation, drive modes, regenerative braking, pedal modes, or the child lock.

topic.description: The vehicle feature or situation the driver is asking about.

function.name: SET_CURRENT_LANE
function.description: Remembers which lane the driver is in now, so the coach can tell exactly which lane to move to before a turn. Lanes are counted from the leftmost lane as lane 1.

laneNumber.description: The lane the driver is in now, counting from the leftmost lane as 1.
